description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ancient Copper Dragon, triggering it, causing you to roll a d20 and create that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat step 3 until you have {3}{R}{R} or run out of Treasures.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ancient Copper Dragon
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent
